ns2:course.label: Junior Business Honors Seminar
ns2:course.description: Focuses on expanding students' knowledge about higher education and the academy through the depth and breadth of University of Illinois faculty expertise. Each week, an invited faculty member will give a brief presentation on their research or area of expertise and lead an interactive discussion session with the students. Prerequisite: Third-year students in the Gies Business Honors program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Third-year students in the Gies Business Honors program.
